Size & Gear
Every door needs a frame — 75mm fits canopy or retractable gear; 60mm is canopy-only. Doubles are supplied with the 75mm double frame.
Canopy gear generally suits single doors up to 2438mm (8'0") wide — wider doors and all doubles need retractable gear. Sizes are standard UK ordering sizes; confirm the exact sub-frame depth against the manufacturer's current chart. Canopy doors also require a Bow Arm Kit.
